sentences.en: Their business came to a standstill for want of money.
sentences.zh: 1. 由于缺乏资金，他们的生意陷入了停顿。

sentences.en: My business is at a standstill because of the recession.
sentences.zh: 2. 由于经济衰退，我的业务停滞不前。

sentences.en: All the traffic was brought to a standstill by the accident.
sentences.zh: 3. 这起事故导致所有交通都停止了。

senses.zh: 停顿,停止，停滞adj.停顿的，停滞的,引起停顿的,造成停滞的
